notes: Grimstad's trademarks: Grimstad kirke (1881, H. Thrap-Meyer; one of Norway's largest wooden churches, neo-Gothic cross church painted light green with yellow-ochre trim, west tower with a tall slate spire) on the rise above the harbour; Ibsenhuset (the old pharmacy where Henrik Ibsen was apprentice and wrote Catilina, a white-painted gable house from 1757, museum since 1916); and the small-boat harbour by Terje Vigens brygge and Dampskipsbrygga below the white wooden old town. Heights estimated from photos (no published figures).
